build_command: export PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/Hale-dwuspadowe && npx tsc -b && npx vite build
test_command: No tests - verify via tsc type-checking only
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx tsc -b to confirm no TypeScript errors. 2. Run npx vite build to confirm the app builds.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Node 22 at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin. pnpm via corepack. No test runner (vitest/jest) installed. tsconfig strict mode with noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters.
contribution_requirements: Code committed to main branch. pnpm build must pass without errors. i18n translations in both pl.json and en.json.
key_patterns: Calculation logic in src/utils/calculations.ts, types in src/types/index.ts, profile data in src/data/profiles.ts, load data in src/data/loads.ts, form UI in src/components/FormPanel.tsx, results UI in src/components/ResultsPanel.tsx, memoized hook in src/hooks/useHallCalculations.ts. The FormPanel has a bug - uses useHallCalculations without importing it. Several 3D files have unused variables. Tailwind CSS 4 with @theme directive.
directory_structure: Root: package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, index.html. src/: App.tsx, main.tsx, index.css, vite-env.d.ts. src/types/: TypeScript interfaces. src/utils/: calculation logic + geometry helpers. src/data/: profiles catalog + loads data. src/hooks/: useHallCalculations memoized hook. src/components/: FormPanel, ResultsPanel, Layout, Header, LanguageSwitcher, ViewPresets. src/3d/: Three.js scene, HallModel, materials. src/3d/elements/: SideColumns, EndColumns, Purlins, Rafter, Truss, CrossBracing, PurlinBracing. src/3d/profiles/: IBeamGeometry, RHSGeometry, SquareTubeGeometry, ZProfileGeometry, RoundBarGeometry. src/i18n/: config.ts, pl.json, en.json.
